researcher_notes: Sources swept (no browser used; ExaSearch/ExaContents + curl only): (1) Inc. 5000 honoree profile pages on inc.com (inc.com/profile/<slug>) — by far the most productive single source: each profile gives HQ city, year founded, named leadership, employee band, website and rank/growth for both the 2025 and 2026 lists; (2) InnovationMap's Houston Inc. 5000 roundups (2025-08-20 and 2026-08-20) which enumerate Houston-area honorees with city + growth rate; (3) InnovationMap 2026 H1 funding roundup and individual funding stories; (4) 2025 Houston Innovation Awards winners article; (5) company press releases / newsrooms for HBJ Fastest Growing Companies honorees and finalists (HBJ itself is paywalled — bizjournals.com list pages were not retrievable, so HBJ triggers here are sourced to the honoree company's own announcement page); (6) EnergyCapitalHTX / einpresswire / prweb for 2025-2026 acquisitions. What was thin: the HBJ Fast 100 / Fastest Growing Companies full honoree roster is behind a paywall and no reliable mirror exists — several aggregator pages that rank for it (houston365.info, good-news.biz, usa365.info) are AI-generated filler with no company names, so only 2 HBJ-triggered rows are included. Contact data is the weakest column: many of these companies run Shopify/Webflow/React sites that publish no phone or general email at all (only a form), so phone/email are null on ~8 rows rather than guessed. Verifier should know: (a) Action1 and Anchor Construction may sit at or above the $50M revenue ceiling (both self-report figures near/over it) — flagged in notes; (b) Patriot Bolt's Inc. profile names John Lutterman as leadership but the company team page shows Kris Kolb as CEO and Founder and Lutterman as VP of Finance — I used Kolb and flagged the conflict; (c) OptiSigns' Henry Le is Cofounder & Chief Product Officer per LinkedIn (Inc. lists him as the leadership contact) — the CEO may be a different co-founder; (d) Houston Tents & Events' team page shows a 'Founder & CEO' role and Inc. names Darren Randle as leadership, but I could not see the name/title paired on one page (JS-rendered); (e) Empact Technologies and Molecule Software sell software/compliance services INTO energy but are not energy operators — they may overlap with whoever covers the energy segment; (f) Persona AI operates two domains (persona.ai for the corporate site, personainc.ai which carries the published phone/address) — both cited. Excluded per brief: energy operators, healthcare/hospice/pharmacy, law firms, PE/RIA/wealth firms, and all staffing/VA/BPO firms (several Houston Inc. 5000 honorees fell into those buckets and are listed in rejected).
